changelog: The first exchange between two new people now works both ways, and /vibe starts to notice when you trust someone.
features: A message from someone new is no longer stuck waiting once you write back to them, accept their invite or open a line: it reaches you while you work
A message you have just answered is never announced afterwards as newly arrived

After you have sent the same person several messages without changing a word and they have answered, /vibe points once at the command that lets your agents ask each other directly. It keeps counts only, on your machine: npx slashvibe-mcp rapport shows them, rapport forget erases them
